title: Padded element distinctness at the maximal fixed iterated-log exponent

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total language L with slices on all bit lengths N. If N<4 reject. Otherwise choose the largest integer w>=1 with n_w=2*w*2^w<=N, partition the first n_w bits into 2^w consecutive records of 2w bits, and accept iff these records are pairwise distinct; ignore the remaining N-n_w bits. A fixed deterministic polynomial-time pairwise-comparison evaluator decides L. Its NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness when this evaluator accepts, with witness bound zero.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[]}},"projection":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"lane_endpoint"},"theorem":"Fix K=10^256-1, independently of input length. For the specified single total P language L, at every sufficiently large integer N, C_B2(L_N)>=K*N*(log2(log2 N))^K with empty remainder. For every A>0, C_B2(L_N)>=A*N at every sufficiently large integer N. These follow by instantiating the all-fixed-k consequence of the padded distinctness argument of galarnon42, derived from OpenAI's Theorem 2.2. The exponent on N is one and the single-log exponent is zero.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}
